blocks.html: Implementation Techniques:
blocks.text: Implementation Techniques:

blocks.html: Asynchronous Replication: Updates are sent to all replicas without waiting for confirmation from each.
blocks.text: Asynchronous Replication: Updates are sent to all replicas without waiting for confirmation from each.

blocks.html: Anti-Entropy Protocols: Periodically compare and reconcile differences between replicas to ensure convergence.
blocks.text: Anti-Entropy Protocols: Periodically compare and reconcile differences between replicas to ensure convergence.

blocks.html: Gossip Protocols: Nodes randomly share updates with each other until all replicas converge.
blocks.text: Gossip Protocols: Nodes randomly share updates with each other until all replicas converge.

blocks.html: Conflict Resolution: Use strategies like last-write-wins, version vectors, or application-defined merge functions to resolve conflicting updates.
